title: Bota Singh Decides to Prove that the Khalsa Still Lives

blocks.text: The new episode begins in an atmosphere of false triumph for the persecutors. So many Sikhs have been hunted that many people now say the Khalsa is finished, and Bota Singh mocked as an impostor becomes the sharp expression of that public disbelief.
Those insults do not drive him into hiding. Instead they persuade him that only a bold open gesture can prove the Khalsa still lives and still has the courage to act before the eyes of the state.

Bota Singh therefore establishes a post near Nurddin’s Sarai with a low-caste companion and starts collecting a token toll from passersby. The gesture is deliberately provocative, meant to send unmistakable news to Lahore that the Khalsa has not vanished.
